title: SemDial 2026 “LuffDial”
details: 30th Workshop on the Semantics and Pragmatics of Dialogue, Loughborough University, UK

title: Speech Prosody Lecture — Xiaoming Jiang
details: “Cracking the Communicative Codes of Voice and Speech Prosody: Neurocognitive Bases and Applications”, 13:00 Campinas time. Held as scheduled; the live-stream recording is public on YouTube and in the Speech Prosody Lecture Series playlist.

title: MALiP Summer School, Naples
details: Joint summer school of the Società di Linguistica Italiana (SLI) and AISV, at the Centro Interdipartimentale di Ricerca Urban/Eco, Università Federico II.

title: 6th SPSC Symposium + VoicePrivacy 2026 workshop, UNSW Sydney
details: Joint SPSC Symposium and VoicePrivacy Challenge workshop at UNSW Kensington Campus (Civil Engineering Building K-H20), alongside Interspeech 2026 in Sydney.

title: AVSP 2026 (16th), Sydney
details: First AVSP since 2019; Interspeech 2026 satellite at The MARCS Institute, Western Sydney University (Westmead). Keynote: Michael J. Richardson (Macquarie University).

title: Watermarking AI-Generated Content — Pierre Fernandez
details: Online. Organizer lists 15:00 (CET). Follow its registration link to confirm the timezone.

title: Acoustic Interference — Yanyun Wang
details: Online seminar on audio-model safety. Organizer lists 15:00 (CET); confirm at registration.

title: Speech Prosody Lecture — Peggy Mok
details: 08:00 Campinas time. Listed under “Upcoming Talks” right after the 4 Sep 2026 lecture; the organizer’s page gives the day and month but not the year.

title: Oral sources & archives study day, Milan
details: Seventh edition, at Museo Nazionale Scienza e Tecnologia Leonardo da Vinci. Organizer lists 10:00–17:00.

title: Registration deadline: AI for voice technology course
details: Italian-language online course; organizer lists a maximum of 30 participants.

title: AI applied to voice technologies — online course
details: Nine live sessions in Italian, with practical programming exercises. Follow the detailed timetable for times.

title: ISCSLP 2026, Penang
details: Main conference 14–16 November in Penang; tutorial day 17 November at Universiti Sains Malaysia (USM).

title: Speech Prosody Lecture — Sacha Calhoun
details: 17:00 Campinas time. Listed under “Upcoming Talks” after the 4 Sep 2026 and 21 Oct lectures; the organizer’s page gives the day and month but not the year.

title: IberSPEECH 2026, Madrid
details: Speech and language technologies for Iberian languages. Venue: ETSIT, Universidad Politécnica de Madrid. 70 papers accepted; late registration closes 17 November.

title: AISV 2027, Macerata
details: 23rd national conference, 'Dare corpo alla voce. Rappresentazione grafica e annotazione linguistica', Dipartimento di Studi Umanistici, Università degli Studi di Macerata.

title: Speech Synthesis Workshop — SSW14
details: Maceió, Brazil; satellite of Interspeech 2027 (São Paulo, 29 Aug–2 Sep). The Blizzard Challenge 2027 workshop follows on 9 Sep.

title: Tone and Intonation 2027 (TAI 2027) — abstract submission deadline
details: Listed among upcoming events on the SProSIG homepage. Abstract submission opens 12 Oct 2026; the deadline is Anywhere on Earth. The conference runs 27–29 May 2027 at The Chinese University of Hong Kong.

title: Tone and Intonation 2027 (TAI 2027), Hong Kong
details: The Chinese University of Hong Kong. Listed among other upcoming events on the SProSIG homepage.

title: Blizzard Challenge 2027 — team registration closes
details: Accented zero-shot TTS for spontaneous Portuguese speech (São Paulo, Recife and European Portuguese accents). Preliminary timeline: test data released 1 Feb 2027; results workshop 9 Sep 2027, Maceió.

title: SSW14 — paper submission deadline
details: Final paper submission; the submission system opens 30 Jan 2027. Deadlines are 23:59 AoE.

title: Submission deadline: Computer Speech & Language special issue “Speaker Characterization Beyond Words”
details: Special issue tied to the Odyssey 2026 themes of identity, health and emotion from speech.

title: HSCR 2026 — 8th International Workshop on the History of Speech Communication Research
details: Faculty of Arts and Humanities, University of Coimbra, Portugal; closed with the SIG-HIST business meeting.

title: SIG-CSLP Assembly at ISCSLP 2026
details: Members’ assembly, held with the closing ceremony, 16:30–17:00 on day 3 of ISCSLP 2026, Penang (provisional programme; subject to change).

title: IWSLT 2027 shared-task decisions due
details: Decisions on the proposed 2027 shared tasks are due (the call for task proposals closed 30 Sep 2026). Year-round leaderboards for the compression, offline and instruction-following tasks are already open.

title: IWSLT 2027 scientific paper deadline
details: Preliminary timeline; deadlines are 11:59PM UTC-12:00. Shared-task training and dev data are released 1 Jan 2027.

title: IWSLT 2027 (24th), Kyoto
details: Co-located with ACL 2027. Conference days from the organizer’s preliminary timeline; the site header gives 17–22 Aug 2027.

title: CHiME-9 special issue: submission deadline
details: Special issue linked to the CHiME-9 challenge; submissions opened 1 Aug 2026. Deadline 11:59pm AoE.

title: CHiME-10 challenge opens
details: Three tasks: ECHI-2, URGENT and SG-TSE. Submission deadline Aug–Sep 2027 (TBC); results at a CHiME 2027 workshop planned for December 2027 (TBC).

title: AFCP study day: building, enriching and using speech data, Paris
details: One-day AFCP seminar with talks, round tables and hands-on workshops, with financial support from the GdR TAL. Venue: Université Sorbonne Nouvelle, Paris. Free, with registration.

title: Abstract deadline (extended): AISV 2027, Macerata
details: Abstracts in Italian or English, at least 600 words, for the 23rd national conference (24–26 Feb 2027). The conference site shows the original 30 Sep deadline struck through; proposals are selected by 20 Nov 2026.

title: ISCA Distinguished Lecture — Kai Yu
details: Online, 13:00–15:00 UTC, two hours including Q&A: “Towards Reliable Task-oriented LLM Agents”. Registration was through a Google Form linked from the ISCA page and was requested by 2 October, 13:00 UTC.

title: ISCA Distinguished Lecture — Joseph Keshet
details: Online, 13:00–15:00 UTC, two hours including Q&A: “Speech AI in the real world: noise, latency, and the languages we left behind”. Registration is through a Google Form linked from the ISCA page (requested by 11 October, 13:00 UTC).

title: ISCA Distinguished Lecture — Kong Aik Lee
details: Online, 13:00–15:00 UTC, two hours including Q&A: “Speaker Recognition and Anti-Spoofing: State of the Art, Metrics, and Ethics”. Registration is through a Google Form linked from the ISCA page (requested by 27 October, 13:00 UTC).
